detail.longDescription: Yesterday I made the executive decision to move my blocky instance to my # Kubernetes cluster :kubernetes: This was after the microSD card crapped out and after replacing it with an SSD that also continued to have issues. So now I have it running with 3 replicas, and I’ve still got the exit node and subnet router functionality within the cluster. Hopefully this doesn’t give me any issues. :nkoSigh: :nkoSip: # Tailscale # networking # network # DNS # adblocking # AdBlock # NextDNS 🤓
